note: Hand-authored, not generated. The only place a colour is named. Six palettes, three slots — the user assigns any palette to any slot, which is why nothing here is called 'the pink' or 'the yellow'.

base.note: The ground. Not user-changeable; the three slots are.

palettes.name: Jade
palettes.hint: The dumbbell green. Where this started.

slots.name: Buttons & rings
slots.hint: What you tap and what fills up

slots.name: Coach Nico
slots.hint: Only ever a message from a human

random.note: Shuffles the three slots once a week, seeded by the week number so it is the same all week rather than changing on every render.

motion.note: Budgets, not suggestions. Anything outside these repaints every frame on a phone.
